'''Echo Station 5-T-7''', also '''five-tee-seven''', was one of several [[Echo Station/Legends|Echo Station]] sentry posts positioned around the defensive perimeter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
